full_judgment: 5. Mr Abdur Razaque Khan, learned Additional Attorney-General appearing on behalf of the State, opposes the appeal and submits, inter alia, that during relevant period section 6(IA) of the Criminal Law Amendment Act of 1958, hereinafter referred to as the Act, was in force according to which a notification in the official gazette directing an absentee accused for appearance before to the court was sufficient. At the time of hearing the learned Additional Attorney-General produced Memo No. 4561 dated 30-3-2004 issued by the Deputy Director (Raj/Rangpur), Bureau of Anti-Corruption Bangladesh, and submits with reference to the above memo dated 30-3-2004 that under Memo No. 520 dated 8-5-1986 the learned Divisional Special Judge, Rajshahi wrote to the Cabinet Division Dhaka for according sanction to prosecute the appellant and there being no further material as to refusal of sanction the legal presumption is that of according sanction to prosecute the appellant and, as such, there is no error in the decision.
